question: A circular park having a radius of 14 m. If a 1.5 m wide path is built around it, what is the approximate area of the path?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of a circular path outside a circle = π × w × (2r + w)

Area = (22 ÷ 7) × 1.5 × (2 × 14 + 1.5)

Area = (33 ÷ 7) × 29.5 = 973.5 ÷ 7 ≈ 139.07 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 139 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Radius of the circular park, r = 14 m

⇒ Width of the path built around it, w = 1.5 m

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Area of the path = Area of the outer circle − Area of the inner circle

⇒ Area of a circle = πR²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Outer radius, R = r + w

⇒ R = 14 + 1.5 = 15.5 m

⇒ Area of the path = πR² − πr²

⇒ Area = π × (15.5² − 14²)

⇒ Area = (22 ÷ 7) × (15.5 + 14) × (15.5 − 14)

⇒ Area = (22 ÷ 7) × 29.5 × 1.5

⇒ Area = (33 ÷ 7) × 29.5

⇒ Area = 973.5 ÷ 7 ≈ 139.07 m²

⇒ The approximate area of the path is 139 m².

**∴ The correct answer is 139 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Circular Path Outside

When a path of width 'w' is constructed outside a circle of radius 'r', the Area is calculated as πw(2r + w).

Area of Circular Path Inside

When a path of width 'w' is constructed inside a circle of radius 'r', the Area is calculated as πw(2r − w).

Area of a Circle

The total space occupied by a circular region is denoted by πr².
